entities.name: Devas
entities.description: A village in Benalia founded by refugees from Serra's Realm in 3655 AR.

entities.name: Lyanii
entities.description: Almost-immortal Warden who led Devas's defense.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: Clan whose scions the Serrans trained.

entities.name: Clan Ortovi
entities.description: Clan on whose border Devas was founded.

entities.name: Collapse of Serra's Realm
entities.description: Event Lyanii lived through almost 300 years earlier.

events.summary: Refugees from Serra's Realm found Devas on the border between Clan Capashen and Clan Ortovi lands.
events.quote: The village of Devas was founded by refugees from Serra's Realm in 3655 AR

events.summary: With Urza's aid, Lyanii and the Serrans train the Capashen scions in military matters, eventually leading Benalia to drop its ban on Serranism.
events.quote: Lyanii and the Serrans were put in charge of training the Capashen scions in military matters

relations.quote: Devas's defense was led by the almost-immortal Warden Lyanii
